paper_title: One-Electron Quantum Cyclotron as a Milli-eV Dark-Photon Detector
notes: Proof-of-principle measurement with a single trapped electron in a Penning trap. Sets epsilon < 3.2e-11 at m_A' = 0.612276 meV (148.048 GHz), 90% CL, ~75x better than prior XENON1T constraints. Sensitivity bandwidth is very narrow (~100-200 kHz, i.e., ~1e-6 fractional), encoded here as a two-point flat band around the central mass. Paper also contains a future projection (ne=10 electrons, spherical trap, epsilon ~ 8e-11 over 0.1-1 meV), which is NOT included in data_points since the primary reported result is the measured limit. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.9, 2))
